dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Anti-Homer-3 antibody-associated paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration (autoimmune cerebellitis with anti-Homer-3 antibodies, most likely paraneoplastic — small cell lung cancer being the principal association — pending FDG-PET)

Alternatives:
1. Idiopathic (non-paraneoplastic) anti-Homer-3 antibody-associated autoimmune cerebellar ataxia, with occult small cell lung cancer not yet identified
2. Other paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration (anti-Yo, anti-Hu, anti-Ri, anti-SOX1, anti-Zic4, anti-CV2/CRMP5, anti-Kelch11, anti-PCA-2) with an unrevealed antibody or in seronegative paraneoplastic form
3. Post-infectious / acute cerebellitis of another autoimmune aetiology (e.g., anti-mGluR1, anti-GAD, anti-DPPX, anti-CASPR2)
